heading: INT. STALLED ELEVATOR, TWENTY-SECOND FLOOR - DAY

units.text: INT. STALLED ELEVATOR, TWENTY-SECOND FLOOR - DAY
A mahogany-panelled elevator with a brass nameplate: CALLOWAY & PRIDE, ASSET MANAGEMENT.
The numbers above the door read 22 and flicker.
On the floor sits a large sheet cake in a cardboard box.
HORACE PRIDE, sixty, the firm's senior partner, in a three-piece suit, grips the handrail.
GLORIA MENDELSOHN, forty, an executive assistant with an orange lanyard, holds a clipboard to her chest.
TERRENCE "TERRY" BOOTH, twenty-five, a mailroom clerk, clutches a bundle of envelopes and a balloon on a string.
The elevator lurches.
Horace and Gloria both grab for the cake box.
Terry throws himself across it.
The three of them end up in a heap on the carpet, the balloon bobbing above them, the cake intact.
Get off the cake!
units.name: HORACE

units.text: I'm saving the cake!
units.name: TERRY

units.text: You're sitting on the cake!
units.name: GLORIA

units.text: Terry rolls away.
Gloria lifts the lid.
Across the top, in blue icing: CONGRATULATIONS ON YOUR RETIREMENT, HORACE.
I'm not retiring.
units.name: HORACE

units.text: That's what the memo said.
units.name: GLORIA

units.text: What memo?
units.name: HORACE

units.text: The one signed by you.
units.name: GLORIA

units.text: I sign forty memos a day.
units.name: HORACE

units.text: Sir, the party's at three.
units.name: TERRY

units.text: What party?
units.name: HORACE

units.text: Yours.
units.name: GLORIA

units.text: I never agreed to a party.
units.name: HORACE

units.text: You agreed to the memo.
units.name: GLORIA

units.text: I agreed to a memo about a party. Not a party about my retirement.
units.name: HORACE

units.text: Is there a difference?
units.name: TERRY

units.text: There is a difference, Terrence. The difference is that I'm not ready.
units.name: HORACE

units.text: You're sixty-three, Horace. Everybody else on the floor has been ready for you since 2014.
units.name: GLORIA

units.text: That is a cruel thing to say to a man in an elevator.
units.name: HORACE

units.text: It is a true thing. The cruelty is incidental.
units.name: GLORIA

units.text: Should I, uh. Should I press the button again?
units.name: TERRY

units.text: Press whichever one gets me out of this conversation.
units.name: HORACE

units.text: Terry presses every button on the panel at once.
The elevator groans, lurches, and drops a floor.
Horace and Gloria clutch the rail.
Terry hugs the cake.
The balloon floats up and pops against the ceiling.
The doors slide open on the sixteenth floor.
A crowd of colleagues in party hats stares in, holding streamers.
Surprise!
units.name: COLLEAGUES

units.text: Horace and Gloria look at each other.
Terry, still on the floor, lifts the cake, a little squashed, a lot proud.
I am going to need a very large drink.
units.name: HORACE
